rows.analysis: Closest wording to a waste-and-overflow replacement, but no access route, drywall restoration, permit, cleanup or warranty line is supplied.

rows.scope_owner: Lever, plug and spout with diverter; labor and materials
rows.analysis: “Spout/diverter” may describe a different assembly. Confirm parts and contracting entity; shared address/phone with Save-On-Interior does not establish common ownership.
Adjustment-only wording is not a replacement-plus-access price. Silence about drywall is not proof of exclusion; ask for the written scope.

official_fees.item: Category 1P — single residential unit fixture/shower pan/kitchen-bath remodel, max two inspections
official_fees.note: Conditional category; not a confirmed job fee or total price.

analysis: The supplied amounts are owner reports, not independently verified prices. They are shown only in an owner-reported column; verified amounts remain blank.
The arithmetic spread is $479 and the highest supplied amount is about 4.55 times the lowest, but the scopes differ, so this is not a market range or a like-for-like comparison.
None of the supplied scopes explicitly mentions opening and restoring the storage-unit ceiling. Silence is not an exclusion; obtain a combined written scope.
Do not add the official permit fee to a quote until the quote says whether permits/inspections are included and DBI confirms the category.

cost_drivers.impact: Tub-side linkage adjustment or extraction avoids opening and patching the downstairs ceiling; below-ceiling access adds opening, protection and restoration scope.
Adjusting a plunger/linkage ($135 owner-reported) differs materially from replacing a full waste-and-overflow body/tee/trap assembly ($614 owner-reported) or diverter hardware ($550 owner-reported).

cost_drivers.driver: Drywall patch vs finish & access panel
cost_drivers.impact: Taping, texture matching, painting or framing a serviceable access panel are separate from basic plumbing; standalone restoration requires C-9 or qualifying B contracting.
Under SFBC §106A.2(10), minor wallboard repair is not permit-exempt if the ceiling separating unit and storage/garage is part of a fire-resistive assembly (e.g., Type X gypsum).

Cutting/replacing concealed piping triggers permit guidance; July 2026 Table 1A-C lists Category 1P ($290), 11P/M ($320), regular inspection ($519/hr), off-hour ($555/hr), reinspection ($259/half-hr).
Civil Code §1954 written notice for unit and storage-unit entry, water shut-off coordination, contents protection and conditional pre-1978 EPA RRP lead/asbestos screening.
